_comment: CI-only configuration used by .github/workflows/observation-agent.yml. NOT the same as config.json (the local/dev config used for human-invoked runs where all 5 repositories are checked out side by side). The GitHub Actions runner only checks out this one repository (discovery-lab); the other 4 configured repositories are private repos in the same GitHub org and are not reachable from this workflow without a cross-repo read credential this session has no way to provision (see observation-agent/README.md's 'CI Limitations' section for the full explanation). Their paths below are deliberately placeholders that will never exist on the runner, so the agent's existing, already-tested 'SKIP repo: path does not exist' behavior handles them safely — this is not a workaround, it is the documented, intended failure-safe behavior required by EXEC-003. discovery-lab's own path is '..' because the workflow runs this script with working-directory: observation-agent, so '..' is the checked-out repository root.
